rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the abstract convenience or ease something provides.

example.english: This phone feature provides real convenience.
example.traditional: 呢個手機功能真係好方便。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sau2 gei1 gung1 nang4 zan1 hai6 hou2 fong1 bin6

rows.note: Use this for the convenient time when asking someone to act whenever it suits them.

example.english: At your convenience, could you look over this document for me?
example.traditional: 你方便嘅時候幫我睇下份文件。
example.jyutping: nei5 fong1 bin6 ge3 si4 hau6 bong1 ngo5 tai2 haa5 fan6 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase for a handy object or other little item that makes life easier.

example.english: These handy things in the kitchen add a lot of convenience to cooking.
example.traditional: 呢啲方便嘢擺喺廚房度，煮飯方便好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 fong1 bin6 je5 baai2 hai2 ceoi4 fong2 dou6 zyu2 faan6 fong1 bin6 hou2 do1
